points.description: States the property: a spanning tree has a single unique path between every pair of nodes (equivalently, it is loop-free yet spans all nodes, so no duplicate packets are forwarded).

Explains the link state modification: add multicast group membership information to the link state packets, so that once topology and group info are flooded, each node can locally compute the multicast spanning tree (e.g. with Prim or Kruskal). Equivalent wording accepted.
